2 - 4 years of related experience.
Experience with construction and/or general contracting services.

Supports and assists senior project managers on large projects, from the planning and design phase, through the close-out process including but not limited to maintaining project documentation and logs, reviewing contract documents and change orders, reviewing project progress and assisting with inspection, drafting and reviewing project schedules, budgets, construction documents, estimates, etc. (25% time)
Coordinates small design and construction projects, including developing program, bids, and supervising construction and contractors. (15% time)
Takes initiative to make recommendations to modify construction and design contracts to incorporate needs of the project close-out and training. (15% time)

Supports the review of cost estimates. Prepares for review and calculates project estimates for timeliness, labor, materials and budgets using the skill trades or contractors/external vendors, if applicable. Working with the FS PM, verifies construction budget, finalizes funding sources, makes recommendations for project specifications and cost discrepancies. Proposes alternative strategies to achieve intended outcome while meeting budgetary and/or time constraints. (15% time)

Creates projects in project management software. Develops reports and summaries regarding project progress and completion statistics. In consultation with the FS PM, works with financial analysts to project, track and manage the annual budget as it relates to Minor Renovation Projects. (10% time)
Manages project reviews for conformance to regulatory requirements and organization policies. (5% time)

Oversees and ensures all training and close-out documentation meet the contract requirements and are properly turned over to the appropriate entity, including warranties, record drawings and Operations & Maintenance Manuals. (5% time)
Performs organizational and administrative activities not directly relating to projects, including serving on organization committees representing the department or unit. (5% time)

Communicates and transitions relevant documentation and information to individuals charged with responsibility for the delivery of the project. Coordinates and collaborates with FS Customer Relations to review client requests for work and specifications. Collaborates with Building Zone Managers to schedule project completion, access to work sites and inform customers of project work. Communicates with the customer regarding their needs for specialized equipment and material storage/disposal, working with appropriate campus partners and skilled trades. (5% time)

Knowledge of building and construction, design, construction contract administration and California Building Codes.
Project Management skills to include all phases: scheduling, coordinating and estimating minor renovation, repair/modification and preventative maintenance projects.
Skills to develop project scope and drawings.
Knowledge of working in an institute of higher education, or similar environment including research labs, instructional space, residential and commercial facilities.
Computer skills in word processing, spreadsheet, and project management software.
Skill in using project management software, online/web based work order systems.
Good written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including effective negotiation skills.
Knowledge of University of California systems, policies, procedures and regulations.
Good organizational and analytical skills. Detail oriented to accurately proof contracts and other documents.
Demonstrated ability to manage contractors and maintain compliance to the agreed-upon scope of work and budget.
Ability to operate university vehicles for business and operational needs.
Ability to occasionally lift and carry items weighing up to 70 lbs. Ability to work on rooftops, ladders, scaffolding, lifts or stages at height of 25 feet above grade.
